requirement.statement: C# OM SHALL provide Bun-compatible action, mutation, and interceptor inheritance while preserving the C# transactional execution boundary.

case.given: A concrete entity type inherits an action from an ancestor
case.when: The caller executes the action on the concrete entity
case.then: C# OM SHALL invoke the nearest ancestor action registration inside the current action transaction

case.given: A child action overrides an ancestor action and calls CallParentActionAsync
case.when: The child composes the returned parent mutations with its own mutations
case.then: C# OM SHALL resolve the next ancestor action above ActionOwnerType and execute the combined mutations once

case.given: Three type levels override the same action
case.when: Each override calls its parent action
case.then: C# OM SHALL advance the action owner at each call and compose the chain without recursion to the same registration

case.given: The current action owner has no ancestor definition for the requested action
case.then: C# OM SHALL throw InvalidOperationException with a diagnostic identifying the requested action and current action owner, and SHALL roll back the outer action transaction

case.given: A child action composes parent mutations and a later mutation or after interceptor fails
case.then: C# OM SHALL roll back both parent and child mutation effects

case.given: A child action returns a mutation defined only on an ancestor
case.when: The action executes its mutation list
case.then: C# OM SHALL resolve and execute the nearest ancestor mutation registration

case.given: Parent and child types each register multiple before and after interceptors with owner-local sequence numbers
case.when: A child entity executes the action
case.then: C# OM SHALL run each phase ancestor-to-child while preserving registration order within each owner

case.given: An ancestor before interceptor rejects execution
case.when: A child entity executes the action
case.then: C# OM SHALL skip the action and mutations and leave no committed effects

case.given: An ancestor or child after interceptor fails after mutations ran
case.then: C# OM SHALL roll back all mutation effects

requirement.statement: C# OM SHALL validate behavior definitions before changing persistent metadata or executable callback registration state.

case.given: A constraint, computed property, action, mutation, or interceptor references a missing owner type
case.then: C# OM SHALL reject the definition before metadata or callback registry state changes

case.given: A constraint definition uses a scope other than conditional, cross-entity, computed-dep, or custom
case.then: C# OM SHALL reject the scope without persisting metadata or registering callbacks

case.given: An interceptor definition uses a phase other than before or after
case.then: C# OM SHALL reject the phase without persisting metadata or registering a before interceptor fallback

case.given: A callback overload receives a null executable callback
case.then: C# OM SHALL reject the callback before persistent metadata is written

case.given: Persistent interceptor metadata validation or storage fails
case.when: The callback overload returns an error
case.then: C# OM SHALL leave no executable interceptor registered in memory

case.given: Validated interceptor metadata is written but executable callback registration fails
case.when: The callback overload returns an error
case.then: C# OM SHALL remove the newly written interceptor metadata so persistent definitions and registry state remain consistent

requirement.statement: The repository SHALL keep corresponding C# and Bun tests for shared behavior-runtime inheritance and guardrail contracts.

case.given: The C# behavior runtime parity implementation is present
case.then: The tests SHALL cover parent action composition, inherited mutations, exact parent-child interceptor order, guardrail failures, and transaction rollback
The tests SHALL cover the corresponding parent action, inherited mutation, and inherited interceptor ordering scenarios
